title: FemTheme Solo #011 · 여 블랙 글래머·웨이쉰·카우보이 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Chinese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver hammer head, a gold cube-shaped block, a copper barrel-shaped weight, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a tin miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a brown leather cowboy hat, a red bandana knotted at her neck and a silver sheriff star pinned on a thin leather neck strap, a micro strapless brown leather bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal brown leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material glowing softly under the diffused light, the gentle light modelling every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
